bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to the White Earth Nation for the construction of a cultural center.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; WHITE EARTH NATION. +]

[+$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the White Earth Nation to build a cultural center for the White Earth Tribal Community. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to the White Earth Nation for the construction of a cultural center.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WHITE EARTH NATION.

$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the White Earth Nation to build a cultural center for the White Earth Tribal Community.
additions: $5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the White Earth Nation to build a cultural center for the White Earth Tribal Community.
